lines.beyond: north along Harbour Road past Crown Road; south with T1 down the Boulevard to Southside

lines.name: Sunset Line

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Fix for Vantage's N-R1 fault: new tram T3 Sunset Line on Sunset Way, kerbside in the east carriageway at x -331 (tracks -332.8/-329.2, inside the street's -352..-328). It is 71 m from lantern-west (-260,-563) and rocket-west (-260,-296), well inside reach 250. Both ends leave the sheet (y -780 south; x -400 west on Crown Road), so no loop is needed (T-L1, N-D1).

T3 turns from Sunset Way west onto Crown Road with R50 (vertex -331,289, centre -381,239). Checked by hand: outer track r51.8 meets the street edges (x ≤ -328, z ≤ 292). The inner track r48.2 clears the inside kerb corner (-352,268) at 41 m from centre. Margins are about 1.2 m. I chose kerbside over the median because a median line cannot make R50 inside the junction (T-C1).

T3 connects through S1: the S1 trunk crosses T3 at z 0. An S1 station near (-365,0), over Circus Road's median, would be 34 m from T3 (interchange ≤150) and 205 m from Sphere Gardens (station spacing 200–500). Then T3 reaches T1 and T2 via S1 (N-C1).

Kept from tide's draft: T1 through the circus and T2 Harbour Line on Harbour Road. Dropped: the two-way Sky Loop. Its ring-road corners need R≥70, and the arcs would cut over plots (S-C1). The plan's concept is one S1 trunk; open question c1909f (retire the loops?) still needs Sky's answer.
T2 runs kerbside on Harbour Road (x 306). It turns R52 into Comet Row, then R52 into the Boulevard, and leaves with T1 at y -780. No in-sheet terminus. It is 34 m from S1 Harbour (340,0).

T1 loop is redrawn to stay in the Boulevard, the circus ring and the island, at R25/26 (≥ radiusLoop 25). S1 loop is redrawn at R40/45 so each fillet has room on its segment. Its arc peak is at x≈710, inside the 740 limit. The S1 trunk is unchanged.
Open: whether T1 ends on the circus loop or runs up Crown Avenue (c1909f). I kept the loop. Not verified: I have not run the plan checker; all geometry is hand-checked.

handoffs.ask: T3 path 'sunset': place stops 300–500 m apart, e.g. (-331,-620), (-331,-310), (-331,0). Add an S1 station near (-365,0) as the T3/S1 interchange (34 m). On T2 'harbour', add a stop at z≈0 for S1 Harbour, and add the T1/T2 interchange at Comet Row. Re-check N-R1 for lantern-west and rocket-west.
T2 shares T1's track on the Boulevard from Comet Row south to y -780 and on to Southside. Timetable both lines on that shared section. T3 is a new through line, Southside to the West End.
